title: Syrian-Style Smoked Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring smoky lamb kebabs inspired by Syrian cuisine. Marinated in a mix of spices and herbs, these kebabs are perfect for a summer BBQ or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the lamb into uniform pieces for even cooking.

ingredients.name: Lightly smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality smoked paprika for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Syrian allspice
ingredients.notes: This spice is a key component of Syrian cuisine and adds a unique flavor to the kebabs.

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley, chopped
ingredients.notes: Add a burst of freshness with chopped parsley.

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh lemon juice for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the smoked paprika, allspice, garlic, parsley, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
